title: Market Day, From the Bell Tower
summary: Strasbourg's old-town street and squares at noon, rebuilt after an aerial photo and full of market stories: A the whole frame, B the wedding on the hall steps at 8x.
request: rebuild Pexels photo 14037897 (Nick Verlice, "Aerial View of Medieval Buildings on an Old Town": Strasbourg's Rue Merciere seen from the cathedral tower) as sticker-iso at 600x600, delivered 4x at 2400x2400; a market day with a wedding on the hall steps as the hero; a 5 s brass-band sound sample.

outputs.name: sample
outputs.run: python3 sound/march.py sound/08-sample.wav && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i sound/08-sample.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 sound/08-sample.mp3

anatomy.draws: The rebuild brief: intent, sticker-iso style, iso layout, figures, sound plan
anatomy.change_for: intent, mood and the written rules the gate reads

anatomy.draws: Layout of Rue Merciere, the squares and the hall in 2:1 iso world units
anatomy.change_for: the layout and what stands where

anatomy.draws: Palette, slot-map helpers, planar roof painter and the old-town forms (roofs, half-timbered fronts, stalls) drawn into an iso scene
Buildings and props as seeded functions: roof courses, dormers, facades, houses, the arcaded hall, stalls
Hand-typed 13 px iso people, dog, pigeons and the wedding party
Small props: fountain, flower cart, cafe parasols, trees, lamp posts, kite, bicycle, crates
Scene renderer for block-in and final; final exports 08-a at 1x, 2x and 4x, masks, art/palette.json and the 8x wedding crop 08-b (crop offset is argv)
The palette used by the final render, rewritten by every render
Synthesises a 5.0 s oom-pah march in B-flat major at 112 bpm with a crowd murmur; takes the output wav path as argument

provenance.by: parallel Claude agents with a coordinating agent as art director (examples/moments showcase run, PR #21); migrated to library/ on 2026-10-18 without re-review; rebuilt in original code from Pexels photo 14037897 by Nick Verlice (Pexels license); the photo is not in the repository
